name: selective-entity-sync
description: Push selected content between WordPress sites (e.g. staging to production) via entity manifests, with automatic ID remapping.
author: Gabriel de Tassigny

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.makepot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/selective-entity-sync wp i18n make-pot . languages/selective-entity-sync.pot --exclude=node_modules,vendor,build,tests,src-js --domain=selective-entity-sync && wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/selective-entity-sync wp i18n make-pot src-js languages/selective-entity-sync-js.pot --domain=selective-entity-sync --skip-php --merge=languages/selective-entity-sync.pot --subtract-and-merge
scripts.makejson: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/selective-entity-sync wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge
